lessons.title: 2. Memory Slots & Variables
lessons.concept:
### Types in C
In C, every variable must state its exact memory type:
- `int`: whole number
- `float`: decimal

```c
int health = 100;
printf("HP: %d\n", health); // %d formats an integer!
```
lessons.task: Create an integer variable `int speed = 88;` and print it using `printf("Speed: %d\n", speed);`.
hints: The code is ready to test! Click Run Spell to verify!
